title: Watch: Shelter Between Wind and Crops
scope: Illustrated example with authored arrows showing some of the air passing through a windbreak. Qualitative direction and slowing only, not a measured airflow simulation or planting plan.

scenes.label: Wind from the north-west
scenes.narration: Look at this example. The wind comes from the north-west.

scenes.label: Shelter before the crops
scenes.narration: The trees and shrubs stand between that wind and the crops.

scenes.label: Some air passes through
scenes.narration: Some air passes through the windbreak. Other air moves over it or around its ends.

scenes.label: Slower air behind
scenes.narration: The shelter can reduce wind speed behind it. The design and care of the windbreak matter.

scenes.label: Observe your own site
scenes.narration: On your own site, observe the damaging winds before choosing where to plant. This picture is not a planting plan.
